purpose: Compose the Aether repository-release contract into an inheritable, migration-safe organization baseline without redefining its protocol or delivery adapters.

slots.title: Agent profile pointer
slots.description: AGENTS.md points agents to the repository release profile before release-behavior changes.
checks: AGENTS.md links to the repository release guidance

slots.title: Aether release declaration
slots.description: The repository-owned .egohygiene/release.json identifies the pinned Aether declaration contract and local facts.

slots.title: Root changelog
slots.description: A root CHANGELOG.md preserves an exact Unreleased section and promoted history without inventing prior releases.

slots.title: Manual release workflow
slots.description: The declaration names a manual GitHub workflow handoff; a normal pull request does not publish.

slots.title: Release and rollback documentation
slots.description: Repository guidance names its release review and immutable-artifact rollback path.

slots.title: Bounded Taskfile handoffs
slots.description: Taskfile exposes release:plan, release:prepare, release:verify, and release:publish without local credentialed publication.

slots.title: Declared version authority
slots.description: Each declared component has one Aether-defined version authority; commit messages advise but do not select a release version.

repository_facts.one_source_of_truth: The repository declaration owns repository facts; this policy owns applicability and migration semantics.

examples.title: Contract repository
examples.notes: A catalog or Git tag is the component authority; GitHub Release evidence is distinct from other delivery channels.

examples.title: Tool or library
examples.notes: Use the language manifest or package metadata as the sole authority and retain the repository-specific delivery adapter.

examples.title: Container image
examples.notes: A release tag and immutable image digest are different evidence; a registry result is not inferred from GitHub Release evidence.

examples.title: Static site
examples.notes: A reviewed release handoff records site deployment state without treating a source tag as proof of deployment.

examples.title: Publication
examples.notes: Publication metadata is authoritative; DOI or archive delivery remains explicit external evidence.

examples.title: Multi-component workspace
examples.notes: Every component declares one authority; no workspace-wide version is invented from unrelated manifests.

examples.title: Private internal repository
examples.notes: The same local declaration and review boundary apply, while internal distribution and evidence remain repository-owned.

examples.title: Archived repository
examples.notes: Keep the declaration and historical changelog, set release state to frozen, and make new-release handoffs not applicable.

examples.title: Legacy repository migration
examples.notes: Use only while a reviewed, expiring repository-owned exception records nonconforming legacy tags, changelog, or unavailable delivery evidence.

ownership.aether: Owns the release declaration schema, specification, and authoring skill at the pinned immutable revision.
ownership.hygiene: Owns this baseline's applicability, migration, and ownership composition; it does not copy or alter Aether protocol semantics.
ownership.relay: Owns reusable immutable workflow execution and durable report transport after it consumes this policy.
ownership.egolint: Owns conformance diagnostics and report normalization; it does not choose applicability policy.
ownership.pace: Owns previewed, reversible adoption pull requests for existing repositories.
ownership.repository: Owns local facts, component authorities, delivery adapters, credentials, exceptions, release decisions, and final publication review.
